svg.content:
<mxfile host="drawio">
 <diagram id="lab-flow" name="Lab result flow">
 <mxGraphModel dx="900" dy="800" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0">
 <root>
 <mxCell id="0"/>
 <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
 <mxCell id="A" value="<b>stage_lab_panel</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">the model reads the report</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="310" y="20" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="B" value="Printed name<br>in the catalog?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="320" y="120" width="180" height="90" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="C" value="Unit fits the<br>matched marker?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="320" y="250" width="180" height="90" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="U" value="<b>pending · unmapped</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">printed name, value, unit kept<br>can never be approved</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="20" y="255" width="210" height="80" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="G" value="<b>pending · unit gate</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">no canonical value</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="590" y="265" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="D" value="<b>pending · typed</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">canonical value computed</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="310" y="400" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="AL" value="<b>Alert now</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">forced display, analytics go quiet</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="590" y="400" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="M" value="<b>map_pending_observation</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">the user confirms the marker</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="20" y="400" width="210" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="AP" value="<b>approve_staged_source</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">only on an explicit user instruction</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="310" y="530" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="F" value="<b>approved</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">facts, trends, health summary</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;arcSize=20;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry x="310" y="640" width="200" height="60" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;" edge="1" parent="1" source="A" target="B">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e2" value="yes" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1" source="B" target="C">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e3" value="no" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="B" target="U">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e4" value="other dimension<br>(10^9/L vs %)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="C" target="U">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e5" value="no conversion" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="C" target="G">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e6" value="yes" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1" source="C" target="D">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e7" value="critical<br>threshold" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#b85450;dashed=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#b85450;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1" source="D" target="AL">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e8" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;" edge="1" parent="1" source="U" target="M">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e9" value="re-normalize,<br>critical check,<br>learn synonym" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9673a6;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1" source="M" target="D">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e10" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;" edge="1" parent="1" source="D" target="AP">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e11" value="allow_missing_canonical" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;dashed=1;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="G" target="AP">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry">
 <Array as="points">
 <mxPoint x="830" y="295"/>
 <mxPoint x="830" y="560"/>
 </Array>
 </mxGeometry>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="e12" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="AP" target="F">
 <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/>
 </mxCell>
 </root>
 </mxGraphModel>
 </diagram>
</mxfile>
